releases.name: pi 1.13.0
releases.body:
### Added

#### Repository content

- A `write`, `edit` or `bash` `git commit` call that adds a Kata ref the session works to a file under the project folder or to a commit message is refused, and the reason tells the model to describe the behaviour instead. Kata refs only resolve in the local tracker.
  - Set `KATA_REF_GUARD=off` (or `0`) to turn it off.

### Changed

#### Inbox and attention

- A child's assignment or `<kata_binding>` note names its inbox address, `<actor>/<teammate>`, when `KATA_INBOX_USER` is a session address.

### Fixed

#### Requirements

- The plugin works with pi 1.2 and later, whose `before_agent_start` also fires for runs that start from a custom message.

#### Delegates

- A child pi whose first run starts from a custom message joins the plan item that message's text names.

#### Inbox and attention

- A request's text can no longer close the `<kata_inbox>` section or open a tag: `&`, `<` and `>` are written as `&`, `<` and `>` in the section, when the plugin reads the inbox (not under Kata's native pi adapter, which inserts it).

releases.name: kata-cc 1.2.0 (Claude Code)
releases.body:
### Added

#### Repository content

- A `Write`, `Edit`, `NotebookEdit` or `Bash` `git commit` call that adds a Kata ref the session works to a file under the project folder or to a commit message is denied, for the lead and its delegates, and the reason tells the model to describe the behaviour instead. Kata refs only resolve in the local tracker.
  - Turn it off with the `refGuard` option or `KATA_REF_GUARD=off` (or `0`).
  - The mod reads `HOME` to resolve a leading `~` in a path the guard checks.

### Fixed

#### Inbox and attention

- A request's text can no longer close the `<kata_inbox>` section or open a tag: `&`, `<` and `>` are written as `&`, `<` and `>` in the mod's section (with the `contract` option on) and in a live delivery.

releases.name: OpenCode 1.3.0
releases.body:
### Added

#### Repository content

- A `write`, `edit`, `patch` or `shell` `git commit` call that adds a Kata ref the session works to a file under the project folder or to a commit message is refused, for the lead and its delegates, and the reason tells the model to describe the behaviour instead. Kata refs only resolve in the local tracker.
  - Set the `refGuard` option to `off`, `0` or JSON `false`, or `KATA_REF_GUARD` to `off` or `0`, to turn it off.

### Fixed

#### Delegates

- On OpenCode 2.4.2, where every `subagent` call runs in the background, a delegate that starts after the lead's turn ended still works its plan item: it gets its assignment, and its report and hand back are recorded. A second `subagent` call naming that item is refused while it runs.

releases.name: omp 3.1.0
releases.body:
### Added

#### Inbox and attention

- Session attention also covers each ticket the lead claims with `kata claim` (or marks with `kata meta set ... work.attention ok`) and each issue it names with `/todo ref`, not only `KATA_REF`.
  - A ticket keeps attention until the session ends or switches, also after another ticket becomes the plan parent. Kata then flags an open ticket still on `ok` as `needs-human`; a ticket closed first is left alone.
  - A ticket flagged `stuck` or `needs-human` keeps its flag and gets no start, including the flag Kata wrote when an earlier session ended, after a quit and `/resume`. `kata meta set <ref> work.attention ok` run by the lead in its shell clears it and starts attention; run elsewhere it only clears the flag until the lead next claims or names the ticket. Kata leaves the old hand-off message in place.
  - A fork restarts attention for the parent it keeps; a resume in a new process does so only while the issue is still `ok` (after a crash), not after a quit.

#### Repository content

- A `write`, `edit`, `ast_edit` or `bash` `git commit` call that adds a Kata ref the session works to a file under the project folder or to a commit message is refused, for the lead and its delegates, and the reason tells the model to describe the behaviour instead. Kata refs only resolve in the local tracker.
  - Set `KATA_REF_GUARD=off` (or `0`) to turn it off.

### Fixed

#### Inbox and attention

- A subagent reads its own session inbox, `<actor>/<teammate>`, instead of the lead's, so a request can be sent to one subagent.
  - Subagents read an inbox only when `KATA_INBOX_USER` is a session address, and their assignment note names it. A subagent the plugin could not record reads none, and omp's advisor no longer shows the lead's requests.
- A request's text can no longer close the `<kata_inbox>` section or open a tag: `&`, `<` and `>` are written as `&`, `<` and `>` in the section and in a live delivery.

releases.name: kata-cc 1.1.0 (Claude Code)
releases.body:
### Added

#### Install and update

- The plugin folder has a listing icon and a README that lists what the mod runs, changes, sends and stores, for Anthropic's plugin directory.

### Fixed

#### Plans

- Restarting a closed task you own with `todo` reopens it, instead of failing with "no longer owned" when Kata cleared the owner on close.
